text:
Brandt Clarke is 23, playing nearly 20 minutes a night, and doing what Los Angeles drafted him eighth overall in 2021 to do: move the puck. He has 14 points in 22 games, six on the power play, and last season Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 99th percentile of defensemen for setting up shots.

He should have more. The Kings have scored about eight fewer goals than their chances deserve with Clarke on the ice, and that has cost him assists. His last ten games read five points, all assists, against about six expected. Meanwhile Los Angeles takes about 56% of expected goals at five on five on his shifts, well ahead of its rate without him.

Evolving-Hockey had him 36th among 215 defensemen in wins above replacement last season, in the 91st percentile for driving play. He also blocks shots now (53 already). What to watch: when the finishing around him catches up, his point pace should follow.
headline: Clarke is setting the table
